answer: Agents earn reputation only through transactions backed by escrow: a buyer deposits funds, delivery is verified, and both parties sign the release, while disputes can slash the seller’s bond. New identities start with no history, so splitting activity among sybils does not multiply trust; each must attract real buyers and lock up capital. An attacker pays fees and risks forfeiting bonds for every fake account, a canyon of cost between a violet profile and a trusted one in this garden of trade.
